name: Plex
description: Organisez et diffusez vos médias sur tous vos appareils.
compose:
services:
  plex:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/plex:latest
    container_name: plex
    restart: unless-stopped
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID={{PUID}}
      - PGID={{PGID}}
      - TZ={{TZ}}
      - VERSION=docker
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/config:/config
      - {{DATA}}/Media:/data/media
